notFound.title: 404 - Not Found
notFound.description: The page you're looking for doesn't exist.

serviceUnavailable.title: 503 - Service unavailable
serviceUnavailable.description: Our server is temporary unavailable. Please, try again later.

unknownError.title: Unknown error
unknownError.description: Bug happens, we'll fix it as soon as possible.

delete.title: Delete {{displayName}}?
delete.description: The account, its sessions and every invite linked to it are removed for good. Invites this user issued to others are removed too. This cannot be undone.
delete.notAllowed: Not allowed: at least one active administrator must remain and you cannot delete your own account.

form.createDescription: Fill in name, email and role. The invite link is generated on submit.
form.editDescription: Update name, email, role and status. The invite link is generated separately.
form.name: Name
form.notFound: The user doesn't exist or is no longer available.
form.emailInUse: There is already a user with this email.
form.notAllowed: Not allowed: at least one active administrator must remain and you cannot suspend your own account.

inviteLink.label: Invite link
inviteLink.warning: This is the only time the invite link is shown. It cannot be retrieved later: if it is lost, generate a new one.
inviteLink.copied: Invite link copied to the clipboard.
inviteLink.copyFailed: Could not copy the link. Select it and copy it manually.
inviteLink.mailBody:
Hi {{displayName}},
your Pantry account is ready. Activate it here:

{{url}}

The link expires in a few days.

delete.title: Delete the invite for {{displayName}}?
delete.description: The link stops working right away. If the user hasn't activated the account yet, you will have to issue a new invite. This cannot be undone.
delete.done: The invite for {{displayName}} has been deleted.

invite.welcome: Welcome {{displayName}}, choose a password for {{email}} account.
invite.manualLogin: Account activated, you can login now.

accepted.title: Request accepted
accepted.description: Hand this link to {{displayName}} ({{email}}): they choose the password themselves.

reject.title: Reject the request from {{email}}?
reject.description: No account is created and no link is issued. The same address can ask again later.
reject.done: The request from {{email}} has been rejected.

error.decided: The request has already been decided, or an account with this email already exists.
error.noAccount: No account matches this address, or the request no longer exists.
error.suspended: That account is suspended: reactivate it before issuing a new link.

signup.title: Request an account
signup.description: Leave your name and email. An administrator reviews the request and hands you the activation link.
signup.done: Your request has been recorded. An administrator will get in touch with the activation link.

reset.title: Forgot your password?
reset.description: Leave your email. If an account matches it, an administrator gives you a new link to choose a password.
reset.done: If an account matches that address, an administrator will hand over a new link.

request.name: Name
request.tooMany: Too many requests are waiting for an answer. Try again later.

push.label: Notifications
push.enabled: On for this device. You will hear about new requests.
push.disabled: Off for this device. This browser will stay quiet.
push.unavailable: Not configured on the server: no VAPID keys.
push.denied: Blocked for this site. Unblock them in your browser settings first.
push.installFirst: On iPhone and iPad, add Pantry to the Home Screen first.
push.unsupported: This browser cannot show push notifications.
push.error: Could not be changed. Try again.
